security_audit.summary: Several markdown fence detections are false positives, but the skill does document dependency installation and repeated local Python script execution. The confirmed risks are credential handling through GEMINI_API_KEY, a suggested .env file, and command execution examples whose referenced script was not present in the audited package.

remediation.issue: GEMINI_API_KEY is required and shown in shell setup instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege key use, avoid exposing secrets in shell history, and prefer a secure secret store or approved runtime secret injection.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends creating a .env file in the skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Store credentials outside version-controlled skill folders and include explicit guidance to exclude any local secret files from commits and uploads.

remediation.issue: The documentation tells users to run local Python commands, but the referenced script was not available for audit.
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced implementation and dependency files for review, or remove execution instructions until the code can be audited.

remediation.issue: The front matter risk label understates the observed secret and command-execution exposure.
remediation.suggestion: Update the declared risk metadata to match the use of environment secrets, external commands, and any network-backed research service.

content.value_statement: Deep research often takes many searches, source checks, and synthesis passes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured Gemini-powered research workflow.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when autonomous deep research is appropriate, including market analysis, competitive landscaping, literature reviews, and due diligence.
Documents setup steps for a Gemini API key and local environment configuration.
Shows commands for starting, streaming, waiting for, continuing, and listing research tasks.
Describes output modes for markdown reports, structured output, and raw API responses.
Provides guidance on estimated task duration, cost, and token usage.
limitations: The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md; referenced scripts and requirements were not available in the audit.
It depends on a Gemini API key and external service availability.
Research output may require source verification and expert review.
Long-running tasks can incur significant API cost.

use_cases.title: Compare Markets
use_cases.description: A product strategist can request a market overview, competitor landscape, risks, and recommendation themes before roadmap planning.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Literature
use_cases.description: An engineering lead can gather research context, compare technologies, and identify open questions before a design decision.

use_cases.title: Prepare Due Diligence
use_cases.description: An analyst can organize company, market, and technology findings into a cited report for investment review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic]. Include a short executive summary, major facts, open questions, and cited sources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A], [option B], and [option C] for [decision]. Focus on tradeoffs, risks, costs, and evidence quality.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor a Research Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the status of the current research task. Summarize completed steps, remaining work, and any blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Continue With Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the prior research on [topic]. Expand the weakest section, add counterarguments, and produce recommendations for [audience].

output_examples.input: Research the current EV battery market for a product planning meeting.
output_examples.output: A report with market segments, major manufacturers, technology trends, cost drivers, risks, and cited source notes.

output_examples.input: Compare Python web frameworks for an internal API platform.
output_examples.output: A comparison covering strengths, weaknesses, ecosystem maturity, operational risks, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Continue the previous Kubernetes history report with more detail on governance.
output_examples.output: An expanded section on governance milestones, decision bodies, project ownership, and unresolved research questions.

best_practices: Confirm the research question, audience, and decision before starting a paid task.
Use a limited-scope query first, then continue only when the first result is useful.
Review cited sources and sensitive findings before sharing the report.
anti_patterns: Do not run long research tasks for simple questions that a direct search can answer.
Do not store production API keys in a project directory or committed files.
Do not treat generated reports as final legal, medical, financial, or security advice.
